organizacao_tips.esse_botao_limpa_o_text: this button clears the text and the result of the last search.
organizacao_tips.organizacao_junta_suas_: organization brings together your notes, the quick capture inbox and three kinds of source — github repositories, e-mail and links — each in its own tab.
organizacao_tips.notas_texto_com_formata: notes: formatted text (bold, lists, checklist, table…), tags, color, and you can pin, archive or lock them with the PIN. everything saves on its own as you type.
organizacao_tips.nova_nota_comeca_uma_no: "+ new note" starts a note here; from any screen, alt+shift+n opens a quick note. markdown works as you type: "- " becomes a list, "[] " a task, "# " a heading. creating notes earns xp (up to 3 a day).
organizacao_tips.entrada_o_que_voce_anot: inbox: whatever you jot with alt+q (from any screen) without a prefix lands here to decide later — each item turns into an expense, task, note, goal, event or reminder with one click, or gets discarded. with a prefix it goes straight there: "$ 25 lunch" expense, "# idea" note, "! friday 2pm" event, "@ tomorrow 9am" reminder.
organizacao_tips.aqui_ficam_os_repositor: the repositories you connect live here — stars, issues, commit activity, without opening github. syncing earns xp once a day per repository.
organizacao_tips.conectar_repositorio_so: "+ connect repository" only needs user/repository — if you paste the whole github url by accident, kami understands it anyway.
organizacao_tips.o_token_e_opcional_sem: the token is optional: without it you only see public repositories, with 60 requests/hour. with a read token, you also see private ones and go up to 5000/hour.
organizacao_tips.proxima_aba_suas_contas: next tab: your e-mail accounts (imap) and what arrived in them, kept in a local cache. click an e-mail to read it right here, as clean text (no trackers), or open it in webmail. syncing by hand earns xp once a day per account.
organizacao_tips.gerenciar_contas_e_onde: "manage accounts" is where everything happens: add a new account (imap host and port, user, and an app password — not your normal password; gmail, outlook etc. generate this separate password in their security settings), mute or remove existing ones. you can have several accounts, and choose which come selected by default whenever you open the screen.
organizacao_tips.adicionar_link_cadastra: "+ add link" adds a new shortcut. the category is free — you pick the names, and links become groups by category down here.
email_leitor.este_e_mail_nao_tem: this e-mail has no text (only an image or attachment).
email_leitor.o_texto_completo_nao_esta: ─ the full text isn't stored in kami (long or old e-mail) — open it in webmail to see everything.
email_leitor.o_texto_completo_nao_esta_2: ─ the full text isn't stored in kami (long or old e-mail).
nota_rapida.salva_sozinho_esc_fecha: saves on its own · esc closes
notas_vinculadas.criar_uma_nota_vinculad: create a note linked to this item
nucleo_tips.cada_area_da_sua_vida: each area of your life levels up as you act. this is your progress by attribute.
nucleo_tips.o_atributo_mais_atrasado_e: the most lagging attribute and the goal with the nearest deadline — a good place to start.
nucleo_tips.todo_registro_que_voce_faz: every record you make in any module shows up here, in order. undid something (unchecked a payment, reopened a milestone, deleted an item)? the record and its xp leave together.
nucleo_tips.registre_qualquer_acao_manua: log any manual action to earn xp straight into an attribute — up to 50 xp per action.
nucleo_tips.tres_missoes_por_dia_e: three missions a day and one a week, drawn from what you can do right now — they complete on their own when you do the action and give bonus xp. tap a pending one to go to its screen.
nucleo_tips.suas_notas_fixadas_e_um: your pinned notes, and a field to jot something without leaving here. alt+shift+n opens a quick note from any screen.
nucleo_tips.os_habitos_que_valem_hoje: today's habits — one click checks one (+5 xp) or unchecks it. the grid and history live on the habits screen (alt+9).
nucleo_tips.esse_painel_e_seu_toque: this panel is yours: tap here to add or remove widgets.
perfil_tips.seu_nome_cor_e_avatar: your name, color and avatar live here — tap edit to change any of the three. next to them, your overall level and your streak of days with at least one action.
perfil_tips.o_mesmo_progresso_por_atribu: the same progress by attribute as the core, just gathered here in your profile.
perfil_tips.todas_as_conquistas_num_so: all achievements in one place — the unlocked ones and, for the locked ones, how much is left. you can filter by one or more areas.
perfil_tips.suas_notas_fixadas_e_um: your pinned notes, and a field to jot something without leaving here. alt+shift+n opens a quick note from any screen.
perfil_tips.os_habitos_que_valem_hoje: today's habits — one click checks one (+5 xp) or unchecks it. the grid and history live on the habits screen (alt+9).
perfil_tips.seu_mapa_de_atividade_cada: your activity map — each little block is a day, adding up actions from every attribute. the darker it is, the more you logged that day.
aprendizado_heatmap.caption: Learning activity in {ano} — days with records
aprendizado.deletar_trilha: Are you sure you want to delete the track "{trilha}"?
organizacao.conta_padrao: default account (comes selected when the screen opens)
organizacao_email.vazio: no e-mails in cache — click {icone} to sync.
organizacao_github.sem_dados: no github data — the repository may not exist, may be private (no token with access), or the name may be wrong. try resyncing ({icone} above) again.
organizacao_github.nenhum_novo: token saved — no new repositories to import{dono}.
organizacao_notas.vazio: no notes yet — create the first one (or {atalho} from any screen).
organizacao_notas.aviso_chave: heads up: if the password key gets reset, the locked text is lost; the backup WITH a password takes it along.
nucleo_tips.conquistas: milestones that unlock on their own as you use the app. locked ones show how much is left; filter by one or more areas.
organizacao_entrada.vazia: inbox empty. {atalho} jots anything from any screen.
organizacao_notas.dica_atalho: {atalho} creates a quick note from any screen.
